sanskrit: tathā śādhimāṃ nātha yuṣmad guruṇāṃ kṛpā tvayyakhaṇḍā bhavat tena śīghram ||
ye dhyāyanti padatrayaṃ tava śive te yānti saukhyaṃ param ||
siddhirbhavatu me devi tvatprasādāt tvayi sthitā ||
prātaḥ samutthāya tava priyārthaṃ saṃsārayātrāmanuvarta i(yi)ṣye ||
tvayā ca sarveśi hṛdisthayā vā yathā niyukto'smi tathā karomi ||
paśyāmi te sarvajanāṃ tarasthaṃ namāmi haṃsaṃ paramātmarūpam ||
nānayā sadṛśo mantro na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||
brahmaprajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvannodehi vanaspate ||
tena satyena me deva tīrthaṃ dehi divākara ||
narmadā sindhu kāveri jale'smiṃ sannidhiṃ kuru ||
[atha pūrṇāṣibhi(bhiṣi)ktānāṃ viśeṣata snānavidhiḥ | snānaprakāro dvividho vāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ ||
kathayāmi bhavadhva yaṃ ca vargāpta-epi ca ||
pañcabhūtātmabījāni la va ra ya ha itīritāḥ ||
maṅgalaṃ carcikaṃ yogaṃ harasiddhaṃ ca hāṭakam ||
tāṃ devīṃ tanmanuṃ paścāt mūlatejasi yojayet ||
vicitrāṃ bharaṇāṃ raudrīṃ dhyātvā etaṃ manuṃ japet ||
divi loke sthitā ye ca te naśyantu śivājñayā ||
mahadapimahanīye conmanīśuddhavidye sakṛdapi manasā tvāṃ dhyāyate yaḥ sa muktaḥ ||
